text.0: A diverse group of people gathers in an indoor, loft-like space, illuminated by dynamic red and purple disco lighting. In the foreground, a bald man in a white t-shirt with a black bandana and a mountain-and-sun graphic, stands with his back to the viewer, facing a seated audience. The audience, facing forward, watches a speaker in a light green shirt, standing by a table with equipment and art, against a brick wall sectioned with red acoustic panels. Exposed industrial ductwork runs across the ceiling. On the left, a wooden staircase ascends, with framed artwork on the adjacent wall. To the right, kitchen appliances and another person are visible. A prominent circular logo in the bottom right features a stylized pig smoking a joint, wearing an eye patch and hat, with text "CLAUDE" and "SMOKE 'EM IF YOU GOT 'EM".
text.2: A casual indoor gathering is seen from a low, slightly off-center angle, with a large audience of diverse individuals seated in rows, facing a speaker at a wooden table on the right. The room features a rustic-industrial aesthetic with exposed brick walls, a wooden staircase adorned with string lights and framed art on the left, and red sound-absorbing panels on the back wall. Overhead, visible pipework and spotlights emit red and purple light, creating a dynamic atmosphere. A man in a light green shirt stands speaking at the table, while another man moves around a kitchen area behind him. The foreground shows the back of a bald man wearing a white t-shirt with a colorful mountain graphic and a black bandana. A "Claude" logo, featuring a pig with an eye patch, beanie, and smoking a joint, is partially visible in the bottom right corner, with the text "SMOKE 'EM IF YOU GOT 'EM."
text.4: A diverse audience of approximately thirty people, mostly young adults, is gathered in a warmly lit, intimate indoor venue with brick walls, watching a presenter. Many audience members are seated on folding wooden chairs and laughing, facing right. The central figure in the foreground, seen from behind, is a bald man wearing a black bandana and a white t-shirt with a colorful, rectangular mountain landscape graphic on the back. To the right, a fair-skinned man in a light green button-up shirt gestures with both hands while speaking into a microphone at a rustic wooden table. A laptop and water bottle are on the table. The background features a brick wall with framed art, a staircase adorned with string lights, and a red sound-dampening wall. A dark circular logo with a pig wearing a beanie and eye-patch, smoking a cigarette, is bottom-right, reading "CLAUDE SMOKE 'EM IF YOU GOT 'EM".
text.6: A male comedian, wearing a light green button-up shirt, sits at a rustic wooden table on the right, speaking animatedly into a microphone with his left hand extended. He is laughing, facing a diverse, laughing audience filling the left and center. A bald man in the foreground, facing away, wears a white t-shirt with a colorful mountain range graphic and a black bandana on his head. The audience is seated on wooden folding chairs, in rows, within a room with a brick wall adorned with framed art and a staircase lined with string lights. A red acoustic panel is visible on the back wall. Objects on the table include a laptop, water bottle, glass, and papers. The overall lighting is warm and dim. A round logo featuring a smoking pig with an eyepatch and the text "CLAUDE SMOKE 'EM IF YOU GOT 'EM" is in the bottom right corner.
text.8: In a cozy exposed-brick venue hung with framed pictures and a leaning wooden ladder, warm fairy lights sparkle overhead. A laughing, clapping crowd fills rows of mismatched chairs. At the front stands a bald man in a bright green T-shirt, grinning mid-joke at a microphone, gesturing toward a projected slide of a snowy mountain peak. Beside him, a laptop glows on a small table next to an open champagne bottle, a toy pig figurine, and a curl of cigarette smoke. The mood is lively, irreverent, and warmly amber-lit.
text.10: This vector illustration depicts a stand-up comedy scene. A bald, light-skinned person in a green shirt and dark blue pants stands center, smiling widely with one arm raised, holding a microphone. To their right, a small brown table holds an open laptop glowing blue, a green bottle with a white cork and gray squiggle, and a pink mouse toy. Behind them, a dark brown brick wall features a large horizontal painting of three gray mountains with white caps, and three smaller framed images. A wooden ladder leans against the right wall, and a string of orange-glowing lights hangs across the top. Below the stage, an audience of abstract, faceless figures in various colored outfits (purple, blue, olive green, brown, burgundy, orange) faces the performer.
text.12: This monochromatic ASCII art image, rendered in bright green on a dark background, depicts a room with a figure and objects. The central character is a tall, slender figure made of '#' and '=' characters, positioned centrally. To the left and right, the walls are constructed from '-' and '|' characters, forming a brick-like pattern. On the back wall, three triangular mountains with '*`' peaks are visible above a long horizontal line. A small '@ @' icon is in the upper left, while the right wall features vertical 'H' patterns. A small table-like structure and a simple chair are near the central figure. Along the bottom, six small, stylized ASCII figures stand, each labeled with a color: "purple," "blue," "olive," "brown," "burgundy," and "orange." A row of 'o's and '~'s runs across the top border.
text.14: A minimalist, low-poly 3D scene depicts a dark room illuminated by neon green light. The room features dark green walls, with the side walls constructed from stacked rectangular blocks projecting inwards. The back wall has three prominent green triangular shapes topped with smaller diamonds, centered above a horizontal line, and two green circles on the left. Above the triangles, a row of alternating green circles and upward-curved lines decorates the top edge. In the foreground, six small, colorful humanoid figures stand on green rectangular bases, spaced evenly. From left to right, their colors are purple, blue, yellow-green, brown, dark red, and orange. Behind them, a larger, light-green blocky figure with a head resembling an octagonal prism stands centrally, flanked by a simple green chair on the left and a green table on the right. On the far right wall, four stacked "H" shapes are visible.

import * as THREE from 'three';
const W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
const r=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});r.setSize(W,H);document.body.appendChild(r.domElement);
const s=new THREE.Scene();s.background=new THREE.Color(0x020a02);s.fog=new THREE.Fog(0x020a02,20,45);
const c=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,W/H,0.1,100);c.position.set(0,6,18);c.lookAt(0,3,0);
s.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x224422,1.2));
const pl=new THREE.PointLight(0x66ff66,80,40);pl.position.set(0,9,6);s.add(pl);
const d=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x88ff88,1);d.position.set(3,8,8);s.add(d);
const G=(e=0.2)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x33ff33,emissive:0x0a4a0a,emissiveIntensity:e*4,flatShading:true});
const box=(w,h,dd,x,y,z,m=G())=>{const o=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,dd),m);o.position.set(x,y,z);s.add(o);return o};
// floor
box(16,0.2,10,0,-0.1,0,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x052a05,flatShading:true}));
// back wall
box(16,9,0.2,0,4.5,-5,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x031a03}));
// brick side walls
for(const sx of[-8,8])for(let y=0;y<9;y++)for(let z=0;z<5;z++)box(0.2,0.9,1.9,sx,y+0.5,-4+z*2+(y%2?0.5:-0.5)*0.9,G(0.1));
// horizon line + mountains
box(14,0.1,0.1,0,3.5,-4.8,G(1));
[-4,0,4].forEach((x,i)=>{const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(1.8,3+i%2,4),G(0.3));m.position.set(x,5.2+(i%2)/2,-4.8);m.scale.z=0.1;s.add(m);
const st=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.25),G(1.5));st.position.set(x,6.9+i%2,-4.7);s.add(st)});
// @ @ icon
for(const x of[-6.5,-5.5]){const t=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.3,0.08,6,12),G(1));t.position.set(x,8,-4.8);s.add(t)}
// H patterns on right wall
for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const z=-3+i*2;box(0.1,1.5,0.15,7.8,5,z-0.3,G(1));box(0.1,1.5,0.15,7.8,5,z+0.3,G(1));box(0.1,0.15,0.6,7.8,5,z,G(1))}
// top border o ~
for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const x=-7.5+i;if(i%2){const sp=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2,6,4),G(1));sp.position.set(x,9.2,-4.8);s.add(sp)}else{const t=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.25,0.05,4,8,Math.PI),G(1));t.position.set(x,9.2,-4.8);t.rotation.z=i%4?0:Math.PI;s.add(t)}}
// tall figure
box(0.8,3,0.5,0,3,0);box(0.3,2,0.3,-0.25,1,0);box(0.3,2,0.3,0.25,1,0);
box(0.25,2.6,0.25,-0.6,3.2,0);box(0.25,2.6,0.25,0.6,3.2,0);
const hd=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.45,0),G(0.6));hd.position.set(0,5,0);s.add(hd);
for(let y=2;y<4.5;y+=0.4)box(0.9,0.06,0.55,0,y,0,G(1.2));
// table
box(2,0.15,1.2,2.5,1.4,0.5);for(const[x,z]of[[1.6,0],[3.4,0],[1.6,1],[3.4,1]])box(0.12,1.4,0.12,x,0.7,z);
// chair
box(1,0.12,1,-2.5,0.9,0.5);box(1,1.3,0.12,-2.5,1.6,0);for(const[x,z]of[[-2.9,0.1],[-2.1,0.1],[-2.9,0.9],[-2.1,0.9]])box(0.1,0.9,0.1,x,0.45,z);
// six small figures
const cols=[0x9933cc,0x3366ff,0x808000,0x8b4513,0x800020,0xff8800];
cols.forEach((col,i)=>{const x=-5+i*2,m=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:col,emissive:col,emissiveIntensity:0.3,flatShading:true});
box(0.5,0.8,0.3,x,0.8,3.5,m);box(0.15,0.4,0.15,x-0.12,0.2,3.5,m);box(0.15,0.4,0.15,x+0.12,0.2,3.5,m);
const h=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.25,0),m);h.position.set(x,1.45,3.5);s.add(h);
box(0.9,0.05,0.2,x,0.02,4.1,G(1))});
r.render(s,c);window.__ready=true;
</script></body></html>

for(const [x,y] of[[-5.3,4],[-5.3,2.8]]){const c=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.4,.07,6,16),neon);c.position.set(x,y,bz);s.add(c);}
for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const x=-5.6+i*1.4;
 if(i%2==0){const c=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(.25,10),neon);c.position.set(x,7,bz+.02);s.add(c);}
 else{const a=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.4,.05,4,12,Math.PI),neon);a.rotation.z=Math.PI;a.position.set(x,7.2,bz+.02);s.add(a);}}

for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const g=new THREE.Group();g.position.set(6.3,1.2+i*1.3,-1);g.rotation.y=-Math.PI/2;s.add(g);
 box(.1,.9,.08,neon,-.3,0,0,g);box(.1,.9,.08,neon,.3,0,0,g);box(.6,.1,.08,neon,0,0,0,g);}

box(.4,1.2,.4,bm,-.3,.6,0,big);box(.4,1.2,.4,bm,.3,.6,0,big);box(1.2,1.4,.7,bm,0,1.9,0,big);
const armL=box(.3,1.2,.3,bm,-.8,1.9,0,big),armR=box(.3,1.2,.3,bm,.8,1.9,0,big);
const head=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.5,.5,.7,8),bm);head.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;head.position.set(0,3,0);big.add(head);
